name: Nadia
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c136585]Rabiah[/url] is her mother.

Nadia has changed a lot since the shy girl I remember from when she used to come over to play with Ain. Seeing her all grown up reminds me a lot of her mother, back when we were younger. She has the same energy, wild streak and adventurous spirit.

Growing up in a remote village, under the roof of such bore as Omar, she must have felt limited and stifled. I bet she's making the most of her newfound liberty here in Zeta. Omar will have a hard time tying to control her now. I guess her knowing she is not his daughter doesn't help either.
